process_note: First course run under the funnel refinement of the forge-design-direction skill made in this cycle: five directions per series at round one, narrowed to three under reactive constraints at round two, one preregistration-shaped lead plus named runner-up and unpriced residual risk at round three. Occupied-ground disclosure staged at round two so round-one collisions with held ground read as convergent evidence. Series run with staggered parallelism: a later series' round one alongside an earlier series' later rounds, exclusions drawn from round-one territory.
exclusion_note: series 2 round 1 excluded series 1's entire round-one territory (five directions, one abstract line each); series 3 round 1 excluded both prior series' round-one territories plus the project's own occupied ground (incumbent atlas, spent conflict audit, parked movement ledger, gate-refused subsumption census). Exclusion text is embedded in the hashed r1 prompts above.

series_1: empty room -- certified absence via exhaustion certificates
blast radius -- computed retraction closure over a derived-from provenance graph
two witnesses -- one object under two code-independent verifiers, disagreement ledger
bounty board -- adversarial attestation by outside challengers
first light -- machinery-emitted novel statements adjudicated externally
series_2: load-bearing -- premise-necessity witnesses inside single statements
learning license -- discharged obligations before a graded component may own a task
conservativity compiler -- proved translation property over the library's parallel notations
tolerance zero -- exact witness-carrying answers in an approximation-native discipline
outside scoreboard -- calibration via preregistered forecasts scored by uncontrolled events
series_3: known blindness -- a machine-checkable metatheorem naming relationships the matcher provably cannot see
ticket price -- ex-ante cost of moving one epistemic rung
empty chair -- record sufficiency without its author
load-bearing fiction -- the narrative checker carrying geometry proof obligations
cold storage -- reproducibility as a dated, bounded environment warranty
round_one_funnel.disclosed_drift: series 2 disclosed and replaced a first candidate (seeded defect injection into the verifiers) as reducing to series 1's adversarial attestation with a machine actor

series_1.lead: blast radius -- retraction as an operation with a receipt: provenance graph, radius certificates, replay of the two historical retractions as the labeled test set
series_1.folded: bounty board (into two witnesses' optional outside lane); first light (withdrawn until retraction is cheap)
series_1.residual_risk: the graph records data lineage, not conceptual dependency; the gate is fit to n=2 retractions that were themselves data-shaped

series_2.lead: conservativity compiler -- exception-free translation between the canonical and one non-canonical notation, round-trip and matcher-parity tables, verdict vocabulary NO_POWER/PUBLISH/DELETE_FIELD
series_2.dropped: tolerance zero (pinned-license data constraint removes the contact with a real approximate practice); load-bearing kept at rank 3 but not final
series_2.residual_risk: the shared normalizer can manufacture agreement over exactly the distinctions it collapses, and the permutation control cannot see it

series_3.lead: absent author -- machine-attested record sufficiency: hostile-environment provisioning, frozen extension task, unanswered-question log, tacit-dependency ledger, gutted-checkout control
series_3.dropped: ticket price (held-out set contaminated at the source and score-shaped); cold storage merged into the lead
series_3.residual_risk: the task card's selection cannot be controlled away with one maintainer; the rung must carry (n=1 task, self-selected)
